# The Watch's Slate: the Road

*The Gate Watch pays a standing bounty from Brindle's slate: defeat 40 of the Walkers' Road's monsters, stack rats, pool octopi, verge adders or young gloomeyes. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Brindle will pay it again, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|

| Given by | [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 Road monsters ([Stack Rat](../monsters/stack_rat.md), [Pool Octopus](../monsters/pool_octopus.md), [Verge Adder](../monsters/verge_adder.md), [Young Gloomeye](../monsters/young_gloomeye.md))

## Rewards

- 1,540 EXP
- 1,120 mesos
- +40 standing with [Brindle](../npcs/brindle.md)
- +20 standing with Urbanograd
